summary: Adjoint Floquet analysis of the forced jet orbit at Re = 2000: the leading multiplier is real, -1.1573, within 4e-4 of the direct multiplier; the adjoint mode sits at the nozzle lip.
description: Krylov-Schur (k_dim = 128, mode 3.21) on the adjoint of the map of 311_stability_direct_floquet: the solver stores the orbit of 210_baseflow_newton over one forcing period, T = 1 / 0.6, and integrates the adjoint equations backward over it. On an axisymmetric mesh the run needs the correction of the adjoint convection term in nekStab_forcing (axisymmetric_adjoint_term); without it the pressure residual grows by a factor of about 1.4 per step and the run returns multipliers of modulus 1e52. The run stops at step 56 of 128, when the leading multiplier has converged (residual 1.6e-11) and has stood still for 5 steps; 22 Ritz values then meet the tolerance 1e-6. The leading multiplier is real and negative, as in the direct map, and the two values differ by 4e-4 (3e-4 at k_dim = 40). The other converged multipliers of the adjoint map are not those of the direct map: the operator is strongly non-normal, and the second multiplier is -0.9654 at k_dim = 40, -0.9050 after 128 steps and -0.9063 after 56 steps, against -0.9241 +- 0.0458i in the direct map. Only the leading multiplier is checked. The adjoint mode peaks at the nozzle lip, z = 0.64 and r = 0.48, where the direct mode of 311 peaks at z = 20.6. The mode norms are those of the mode files written by the solver, whose normalisation does not change between runs. The values are those of the run named under produced.

leading_multiplier.note: Real part of the leading multiplier of the adjoint map; it is negative, so the instability doubles the period.

direct_multiplier.note: The adjoint map has the leading multiplier of the direct map; the value is the one of 311_stability_direct_floquet.

leading_sigma.note: Growth rate ln|mu| / T of the leading multiplier.

leading_mode_vx_norm.note: Norm of the axial velocity of the leading adjoint mode; its sign is arbitrary, the norm is not.

leading_mode_vy_norm.note: Norm of the radial velocity of the leading adjoint mode.

leading_mode_vx_xpeak.note: Axial position of the largest |vx| of the adjoint mode: the nozzle lip. The direct mode peaks at z = 20.6.

leading_mode_vx_ypeak.note: Radial position of the largest |vx| of the adjoint mode: the lip of the nozzle, r = 0.5.
